requirement: Requests with an unsupported media type receive status code 415 (Unsupported Media Type).
source_headline: Removed 415 (Unsupported media type) error code from general error codes
label: GAP
reasoning: The code never returns HTTP 415. When a POST or PUT request has an unsupported media type (i.e., `request.is_json` is False), the code returns 400 Bad Request, not 415 Unsupported Media Type. There is no 415 error handler or any path that produces a 415 response anywhere in the service.
